title: 第17章 赤霄宗第18章 朱顶羽鹤
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
一夜无话，虽然楚少野昨晚没睡多久，但是还是早早起来了，他让小狐狸看着金线寻宝鼠，自己出去打了一只灵兔回来。
一阶的六耳疾风兔，身形与普通家兔差不多，但是多了两对耳朵。
六耳疾风兔的耳力惊人，能听到两百米外草叶异常晃动的声音，往往捕食者还没有看到六耳疾风兔的身影，它就已经提前逃跑了。
楚少野的运气不错，这只六耳疾风兔先前不知道怎么伤到了一只后腿，跑步的速度大大降低，这才让他抓到。
升起火堆，楚少野熟练的将六耳疾风兔剥皮拆骨，在剖开肚子的时候，一枚淡青色的灵丹滚了出来，赫然是一枚一阶灵丹。
今天的运气真是不错，据说拥有金线寻宝鼠的人会有运气加成，好像还真有几分道理。
楚少野将灵丹捡起来擦干净，递给眼巴巴看着的金线寻宝鼠。
“你可真是我的小福星，这个是给你的奖励。”
金线寻宝鼠乌溜溜的眼珠一亮，这个人还怪好咧。
有灵丹在手，金线寻宝鼠完全忘了楚少野昨晚威逼利诱它的事，典型的有奶就是娘。
金线寻宝鼠张大嘴，啊呜一下就把灵丹囫囵吞了下去，那灵丹相当于它的半个身体大小，它却吞的很轻松。
其实金线寻宝鼠的颊囊里有一个天生的储物空间，可以用来存放它们发现的宝物，来不及吃的东西就放在那里面，省得被其他灵兽觊觎。
楚少野伸出手指点了点它的额头，又从储物戒指中拿出了一枚淡蓝色的灵丹，递给了小狐狸。
灵宠之间也要一碗水端平，不能有了二胎就忽视老大的感受，加上昨天晚上给金线寻宝鼠的那一枚灵丹，已经给它两枚了，怎么着也得给小狐狸一枚。
小狐狸拿到灵丹果然很开心，没先急着吃，而是先蹭了蹭楚少野，嘤嘤嘤的撒娇。
楚少野拍拍它的脑袋，温声道：“去吃吧。”
六耳疾风兔不一会儿就烤好了，楚少野将两根后腿分给两个毛团子，自己吃了两根前腿。
两个毛团埋头苦吃，别看金线寻宝鼠的体型大概只有小狐狸的二十分之一，胃口却丝毫不逊色，它吃一口进肚子里，再啃两口存到颊囊里，竟然和小狐狸同时将兔腿吃完了。
楚少野拿出手帕给两个团子擦嘴，十分肯定，这只金线寻宝鼠愿意答应他的条件，跟他烤肉的手艺也有关系。
将吃剩的兔肉收进储物袋，楚少野将山洞打扫了一下，然后牵出角马，带着两小只继续策马奔腾。

傍晚的时候，楚少野终于赶到一个城镇，这个镇子要比青乌镇大上许多。
楚少野在看到城镇时，就将趴在小狐狸头顶上的金线寻宝鼠拿下来塞进了怀里。
虽然金线寻宝鼠的外貌不好辨别，一般人认不出来，但还是谨慎一些的好。
楚少野进城后先找了一间客栈，安顿好角马后跟老板打听了一下，找到了一间店铺。
这间店铺是也卖储物灵器的，但是规模要比祝余城那一家小上很多。
这次楚少野要买的是兽元袋，就是在青乌镇上那些检测师用来装通灵兽的储物灵器。
之前在祝余城买储物袋的时候，他忽略了这件事，遇到金线寻宝鼠时才想到应该买几个兽元袋，有备无患。
一般的储物灵器并不能存放活物，只有兽元袋可以，但是兽元袋又比较脆弱，只能放一些低阶的灵兽，而且是要被驯服的，温顺听话的灵兽。
楚少野的黑玉戒倒是也能存放活物，但是那里面还放着不少灵丹，他怕金线寻宝鼠进去，把灵丹全都吞了。
content_en:
There was no words all night. Although Chu Shaoye didn't sleep long last night, he still got up early. He asked the little fox to look at the golden thread treasure hunter mouse, and he went out to hunt a spiritual rabbit and came back.
The first-level six-eared wind rabbit has a body shape similar to that of an ordinary rabbit, but has two extra pairs of ears.
The Six-Eared Wind Rabbit's ears are so powerful that it can hear the abnormal swaying of grass blades two hundred meters away. Often, the Six-Eared Wind Rabbit has already escaped in advance before predators even see it.
Chu Shaoye was lucky. This six-eared wind rabbit had injured one of its hind legs for unknown reasons, and its running speed was greatly reduced, so he caught it.
Lifting the fire, Chu Shaoye skillfully skinned and dismantled the six-eared wind rabbit. When he cut open the belly, a light blue elixir rolled out. It was a first-level elixir.
Today's luck is really good. It is said that people who have golden thread treasure hunting rats will have a bonus in luck. It seems to be somewhat true.
Chu Shaoye picked up the elixir, wiped it clean, and handed it to the golden thread treasure hunter who was watching eagerly.
"You are really my little lucky star, this is your reward."
The golden-threaded treasure-hunting rat's dark eyes lit up, this person was quite strange.
With the elixir in hand, the Golden Thread Treasure Hunting Rat completely forgot about Chu Shaoye's intimidation and inducement last night. It is a typical example of a mother who has breasts.
The golden-threaded treasure-hunting rat opened its mouth wide and swallowed the elixir whole in one go. The elixir was half the size of its body, but it swallowed it easily.
In fact, there is a natural storage space in the cheek pouch of the golden-threaded treasure-hunting rat, which can be used to store the treasures they find. Food that is too late to eat is placed there to avoid being coveted by other spiritual animals.
Chu Shaoye stretched out his finger and tapped its forehead, then took out a light blue elixir from the storage ring and handed it to the little fox.
There should be a bowl of water between spiritual pets. You can't ignore the feelings of the eldest child when you have a second child. In addition, you have already given two of the elixirs to the golden-threaded treasure hunter mouse last night. No matter what, you have to give one to the little fox.
The little fox was really happy to get the elixir. Instead of rushing to eat it, he rubbed Chu Shaoye first, cooing and coquettishly.
Chu Shaoye patted its head and said warmly: "Go and eat."
The six-eared wind rabbit was roasted in a short time. Chu Shaoye divided the two hind legs between the two fur dumplings and ate the two front legs himself.
The two furballs ate hard. Even though the golden-threaded treasure hunter mouse was only one-twentieth the size of the little fox, its appetite was not inferior at all. It took one bite into its stomach, took two more bites and stored them in its cheek pouches. It actually finished the rabbit legs at the same time as the little fox.
Chu Shaoye took out a handkerchief and wiped the mouths of the two dumplings. He was very sure that the golden thread treasure hunter's willingness to agree to his conditions had something to do with his barbecue skills.
Putting the leftover rabbit meat into a storage bag, Chu Shaoye cleaned the cave, then took out the wildebeest and continued galloping with the two young ones.
In the evening, Chu Shaoye finally arrived at a town, which was much larger than Qingwu Town.
When Chu Shaoye saw the town, he took off the golden treasure hunter mouse lying on the head of the little fox and stuffed it into his arms.
Although the appearance of the golden thread treasure hunter rat is difficult to distinguish and most people cannot recognize it, it is still better to be cautious.
After Chu Shaoye entered the city, he first found an inn. After settling in the wildebeest, he inquired with the boss and found a shop.
This shop also sells storage items, but its scale is much smaller than the one in Zhu Yucheng.
What Chu Shaoye wants to buy this time is the beast element bag, which is the storage device used by the inspectors in Qingwu Town to hold psychic beasts.
When he bought storage bags in Zhu Yucheng before, he ignored this matter. Only when he encountered the golden thread treasure hunter did he think that he should buy a few beast element bags to be prepared.
Ordinary spiritual storage devices cannot store living creatures, only beast element bags can, but beast element bags are relatively fragile and can only hold some low-level spirit beasts, and they must be tamed, docile and obedient spirits.beast.
Chu Shaoye's black jade ring can also store living things, but there are still a lot of elixirs in it. He is afraid that the golden thread treasure hunting rats will get in and swallow all the elixirs.
